# Join us on discord.gg/playbladecity to shape the game

A rookie Ninja Monkey with a rusty blade, an empty wallet, and one impossible dream...to become the Master of the Blades 🥷

⚔️ Dodge & deflect your way through **6 game modes** (with more coming soon) to earn coins 💰

✨ Master your blades, unlock powerful abilities, and increase your aura.

📅 Complete Daily & Weekly Quests to earn even more rewards.

💰 Get rich.💪 Level up. 🎉 Throw rooftop parties. 🪩 Flex your drip.
[media]

[media]

Wanna help us build arena maps, blades, and expand this Ninja City? 🤝🏙️

⚔️ Join our Discord to compete in community tournaments, share feedback, and help shape Blade City. 

discord.gg/playbladecity
